title: Structure Configurator
description: Adds structure search, spacing, and safety configs.
body:
Adds structure search, spacing, and safety configs to control where structures can be placed, their spacing from each other, and protects the server against crashing from jigsaw errors and random-source errors.

## Details

- Configures structure search radii for worldgen, maps, and locate commands.
- Configures random-spread spacing and separation.
- Warns instead of crashing on some missing registry entries.
- Guards legacy random-source crashes and bad jigsaw final states.
- Adds structure diagnostics commands.
- Keeps the `structureconfigurator` mod id for compatibility.
